headline: Solomon Islands Ends Security Pact With China in Favor of Australia
summary: Solomon Islands announced the cancellation of its security agreement with China, re-establishing Australia as its primary security and defense partner in the Pacific region.
why: Geopolitical alliances across South Pacific island nations influence maritime trade security and regional infrastructure concessions between Western and Chinese powers.

impacts.name: Solomon Islands
impacts.why: Shifting bilateral security arrangements redefines diplomatic and trade links across Oceania.
